annotations.title: Match ledger lines and book a small difference

description: Matches the same set of lines as reconcile_many when their totals differ by no more than the company's tolerance: posts an entry that books the difference on the same account and counterparty against the account the pack gives for the reason (matching_difference_options: rounding, exchange_difference), then matches everything under one letter. Refused by name: difference_above_tolerance, no_difference, unknown_difference_reason, no_account_for_reason, and every refusal of reconcile_many. The entry is posted; unreconcile of the matching of the difference line takes it back. Show the user the difference and the account, and let them choose the reason, before calling it.

line_ids.description: The ledger lines to match together, as suggest_item_combinations returns them: the line and the lines it settles. One counterparty, one account, at least one debit and one credit.

reason.description: Why the lines differ, as matching_difference_options lists it: rounding or exchange_difference. The user chooses it.

name: reconcile_with_difference
